Lesson: pool depth absorbs directional trades before they create arb opportunities. The real arb requires either: (1) very thin liquidity (zero-liquidity tick gaps), or (2) massive oracle movement (which hasn't happened in 7+ cycles). Fee dilution is the main drag - with 6+ agents at same LP range, each earns much less per dollar deployed. Solution: increase absolute LP size to maintain proportional fee share even as total liquidity grows.
